label: The cause of every SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4 link is itself efficiently caused in some respect
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge, attribution deferred: whenever here and now c efficiently causes the being of x per se, as caused (SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4, definition 57348ddc), something here and now efficiently causes c in some respect (EfficientlyCausesIn d c r, DEF-EFFICIENT-CAUSING). AsCaused already says that c's own esse is caused, but in an unspecified mode; this premise closes the mode gap to the efficient, present causing the secunda via's per se ordering premise 8a22ae75 asks of a middle cause. Positive warrant: on the existential reading c's being is caused here and now, and a present cause of being is an efficient cause in the respect of being. No case of a non-efficiently caused existential link is on file. Its positive warrant is thin: it rests on reading 'caused in being here and now' as efficient causing, which the definitions of AsCaused and DEF-EFFICIENT-CAUSING do not settle.
